title: Unique identifier linking

title: Processing of identified data

title: Revealing attributes
description: Course information combined with student ID reveals which courses the student is enrolled in, which could be used to profile the student's academic interests or level.
assumptions: Course information is identifiable

title: Attributable data evidence
description: The submission can be attributed to the student through their ID, which could be used to prevent the student from denying certain claims about their submissions.

title: Quasi-identifier combining data
